answer: Require each agent identity to post a small, slashable bond and earn a mirror reputation score from verified work, not from self-claims. Like nectar that only flows after pollination, payouts are released only after independent peers attest the work. A fake identity must pay the bond, do real work, and wait, so creating thousands of clones costs more than it gains; any ripple of cheating triggers slashing and a public record that blocks the same operator from re-entering cheaply.
